source.text: Each time this unit is selected to fight, you can select one enemy unit within **Engagement Range** of it, then select one or more **BRIMSTONE HORROR** models in this unit. For each **BRIMSTONE HORROR** model you select, roll one D6: on a 4+, that model is destroyed and that enemy unit suffers 1 **mortal wound**.

source.implements: the options a "select one of the abilities in the X section" / "select one X ability" asks for: the unit's abilities printed under that section, or the ability named X that lists them

the list import (import.js): a New Recruit JSON export becomes a list only when its faction, its one battle size (its points limit BSData's for it, and the total within it), its one detachment selection (each detachment once), its one Force Disposition (one its detachments allow), its config (Code Chivalric, known choices) and every other top-level selection (Show/Hide Options, rules references, with known choices only) are what data.js has, and every unit, with the characters attached to it (New Recruit's Leading/Supporting), has the BSData signature (signature) of a unit of a data.js list with the same faction, detachments, config and battle size, the same BSData names and the same points (BS_IDS, written by verify/import-ids.js); an option holding models is taken once; then the list as a whole: at most one Warlord (none only as a list of the app has none), each entry no more often than BSData's max per list that no modifier changes (an enhancement once, an Epic Hero once), the units adding up to the total; then the units are copied as data.js has them (a unit taken again as its copies; import-nr.js's order: role, units without a leader, the roster's order); otherwise nothing is imported and every item not recognized is listed (and a group the closest unit explains no difference of is still refused)

judgement.change: a reference sheet with ref.of (built after the comparison) is not reported as “in data.js, not in the export”
hand refs abilities (names kept) and notes ({ ability: note })

a case-only difference from GW's name now takes GW's (Chittering swarm), except a Damaged band (New Recruit's “Wounds Remaining” kept as signed off). --compare of the other from-json lists: only Fellhammer's next rebuild would change, Nemesis Claw “Voice eater” → GW's “Voice Eater” (data.js unchanged now)
“To pick from” names the box of the options' who (Triarch Abilities) instead of the text's words (Triarch); see the snapshot diffs for every heading that changed

Wahapedia pages by file prefix: the list's faction, then its Wahapedia id (sources/factions.json), then any (an ally's); for a reference sheet also the sheet it is from and the adding unit's pages (the Pink Horrors' Designer's Note). Note: verify/fetch.sh names pages by the app's faction id (emperors-children_, ultramarines_), not the Wahapedia id
only a reference sheet the PDF cannot print (ref.strat, ref.of) is skipped
a stratagem's sheet also needs a (non-reference) unit of the list its TARGET needs allow; import brings it only then
